summary: No aerial on Commons (the 2017 flyover photo shows the jets, not the bowl). Day: 2016 pregame panorama from the top of the north end; night: 2005 elevated end-zone view with fireworks.

files.author: B (Commons user)

files.note: Top-of-stadium panorama from the north end looking down the full length of the field toward the south end zone stands, crowd filling in pregame; field centered, roughly rows 400-780. Wide format (2400x927).

files.author: B (Commons user)

files.note: Portrait shot from high in the stands looking down the field under the lights with fireworks overhead; field in the bottom quarter, roughly rows 1190-1600. Only 1200 px wide; predates the 2006 south end zone addition.

closest_misses.why: 2020 elevated view of the empty south end zone at 6000 px; good alternate day photo, but the 2016 pregame view shows the whole bowl with a crowd.
Night, but a crowd storming the field with identifiable fans in front.
